description: Automated web accessibility audit of a page in a real browser with axe-core: every WCAG 2.2 level A and AA rule that can be tested automatically (missing alt text, unlabeled buttons and form fields, color contrast, keyboard traps, ARIA errors, missing page language, touch target size). Returns a grade A to F, violations sorted by impact (critical, serious, moderate, minor) with the WCAG criteria, number of affected elements, example selectors and HTML, and a fix hint, plus whether the page links an accessibility statement. For the EU Accessibility Act (EAA), the German BFSG (in force since 28 June 2025) and Austrian BaFG, which build on EN 301 549 and WCAG 2.1 AA. Option mobile for a 390 px phone viewport. Automated rules catch about a third of barriers; this is a screening, not a certification and not legal advice. Not charged when the page cannot be loaded. Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://www.openstreetmap.org"}.

mobile.description: Audit at phone width (390x844) instead of desktop (1280x800)
